name: Action Bar
description: Floating icon toolbar with a glassy lens pointer that springs between buttons on hover and selection, plus delayed label tooltips above each icon.
contents: Row of icon buttons with accessible labels
Glass lens pointer following hover and selection
behavior: Pointer glides with a spring easing to the hovered or focused button and returns to the selected one on leave
Click selects a button and fills its icon with the accent color
Tooltip appears after a delay, and faster when moving between buttons
Pointer position is re-measured with a ResizeObserver

props.name: items
props.default: 6 sample items (Profile, Pinned, Following, Inbox, Edit, Business)

editableByProps: Number of buttons, their Material Symbols icon names and labels
Initially selected button and tooltip timings

needsCodeEdit.change: Change bar surface or border colors

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the Material Symbols Outlined icon font through a link element, so icon values must be Material Symbols names
Lens distortion uses an SVG backdrop filter that may not render in all browsers
